name: io.github.hasanyelaldi/repo-pulse-mcp
title: repo-pulse
description: Read-only git insights for AI: PR review context, bug hotspots, code ownership, release notes

environmentVariables.name: REPO_PULSE_REPOS
environmentVariables.description: Absolute paths of the git repositories to serve, separated by ':' (';' on Windows)

environmentVariables.name: REPO_PULSE_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated toolsets (review, ownership, releases, history) or tool names to enable; all tools by default
